stem: Fenwick Robotics needs every packet between a growing group of VPCs to pass through a set of third-party network-security boxes that AWS scales automatically, before any of it reaches a workload.

choices.text: Front the VPCs with a Network Load Balancer
Front the VPCs with an Application Load Balancer
Place a Gateway Load Balancer in front of the appliance fleet
Configure Amazon Route 53 weighted routing across the VPCs

rationale: Gateway Load Balancer is built to insert a scalable fleet of virtual appliances transparently at a single entry and exit point for all IP traffic. Network Load Balancer distributes transport-layer connections to targets but is not built for appliance-fleet insertion. Application Load Balancer only understands HTTP/HTTPS, not every IP packet. Route 53 weighted routing directs DNS resolution between resources, it does not insert an inspection point into the traffic path.
